_about: Definitions shown as tooltips in the dataset page's full DATS record, keyed by DATS path (extraProperties by category). Source: CONP-PCNO/conp-documentation CONP_DATS_fields.md, "Status and Short Description" column (the help text where that column only gives a condition), without the REQUIRED/RECOMMENDED markers and sentences addressed to contributors. Shortened from the guide's help text: distributions.access.authorizations, distributions.formats, distributions.size, extraProperties.CONP_status, extraProperties.REB_statement, extraProperties.derivedFrom, extraProperties.logo, licenses, privacy. Not in the guide: alternateIdentifiers, creators.affiliations, creators.roles, distributions, distributions.access, extraProperties.Total number of sessions, extraProperties.downloadOptions, extraProperties.evidence_publication, extraProperties.osf_node_id, extraProperties.source, extraProperties.zenodo_record_id, identifier, primaryPublications.identifier, storedIn. To change a definition, change the field guide first, then run bin/build_dats_field_definitions.py.

fields.acknowledges: Grant(s) which funded and supported the work reported by the dataset.
fields.alternateIdentifiers: Other identifiers for the same dataset.
fields.creators: The person(s) or organization(s) which contributed to the creation of the dataset.
fields.creators.affiliations: The organizations the creator belongs to.
fields.description: A textual narrative comprised of one or more statements describing the dataset.
fields.dimensions: Different dimensions (granular components, i.e., handedness, weight, number of time event X happened per day, etc.) making up a dataset. Providing dimensions gives more details about the data types.
fields.distributions: How the dataset is distributed: formats, size and access.
fields.distributions.access: Where and under what conditions the dataset can be obtained.
fields.distributions.access.authorizations: Types of verification that accessing the resource is allowed: public (available to anyone), registered (available to users authorized by the creator) or private (available only to the creator).
fields.distributions.access.landingPage: Web address (URL) where the original dataset can be found.
fields.distributions.formats: The technical format of the dataset distribution (for example csv, nifti, txt, fasta).
fields.extraProperties.CONP_status: "CONP" = created using funding from the CONP; "Canadian" = created in Canada without CONP funding; "external" = created outside of Canada.
fields.extraProperties.REB_number: Ethics committee approval number (required for human research data).
fields.extraProperties.REB_statement: The ethics permissions for the dataset.
fields.extraProperties.Total number of sessions: The number of recording or scanning sessions in the dataset.
fields.extraProperties.derivedFrom: The source dataset this dataset was derived from.
fields.extraProperties.downloadOptions: How the files are obtained; "offsite" means only from the data provider's own site.
fields.extraProperties.evidence_publication: The NeuroLibre/Evidence publication built on this dataset.
fields.extraProperties.experimentDevices: Hardware used to run the experiment.
fields.extraProperties.experimentFunctionsAsses: The functions assessed by the experiment.
fields.extraProperties.experimentLanguages: Languages in which the experiment is available.
fields.extraProperties.experimentModalities: The reactions measured during the experiment.
fields.extraProperties.experimentSoftware: Software used to run the experiment.
fields.extraProperties.experimentStimuli: The stimuli used during the experiment.
fields.extraProperties.experimentValidation: Methods used to validate the results of the experiment.
fields.extraProperties.files: The number of files in the dataset.
fields.extraProperties.logo: The logo displayed on the resource landing page.
fields.extraProperties.origin_city: Principal city where this dataset was created.
fields.extraProperties.origin_consortium: Name of the consortium where this dataset was created (if applicable).
fields.extraProperties.origin_country: Principal country where this dataset was created.
fields.extraProperties.origin_institution: Name of the institution where this dataset was created (if applicable).
fields.extraProperties.origin_province: Principal province/state where this dataset was created.
fields.extraProperties.osf_node_id: The OSF project this dataset was imported from.
fields.extraProperties.parent_dataset_id: Identifier (DOI, ARK, or other persistent identifier) of the source dataset used to generate this dataset.
fields.extraProperties.registrationPage: URL of the registration page where users can obtain access credentials or the email of a contact person who manages access.
fields.extraProperties.source: The repository the CONP crawler imported this dataset from.
fields.extraProperties.subjects: The number of subjects in the dataset.
fields.extraProperties.zenodo_record_id: The Zenodo record this dataset was imported from.
fields.identifier: A code uniquely identifying the dataset locally to a system or globally, and who minted it.
fields.identifier.identifier: A code uniquely identifying the dataset locally to a system or globally.
fields.identifier.identifierSource: Information about the organization/namespace responsible for minting the identifier.
fields.isAbout: Entities (biological entity, taxonomic information, disease, molecular entity, anatomical part, treatment) associated with this dataset.
fields.keywords: Tags associated with the dataset, which will help in its discovery.
fields.licenses: The license(s) under which the dataset can be used.
fields.primaryPublications: The primary publication(s) associated with the dataset, usually describing how the dataset was produced.
fields.primaryPublications.identifier: A code uniquely identifying the publication locally to a system or globally (DOI or ARK), and who minted it.
fields.primaryPublications.identifier.identifie: A code uniquely identifying an entity locally to a system or globally.
Information about the organization/namespace responsible for minting the identifier.
fields.primaryPublications.publicationVenue: The name of the publication venue where the document is published (if applicable).
fields.primaryPublications.title: The name of the publication, usually one sentence or short description of the publication.
fields.privacy: The privacy level of the dataset: open (shared with the public), registered (for users who create an account or request access), controlled (after an application and approval) or private (only researchers involved in the project).
fields.producedBy: Process which generated a given dataset. For example: a pipeline, a software, etc.
fields.spatialCoverage: The geographical extension or span covered by the dataset.
fields.storedIn: The repository or data store holding the dataset.
fields.title: Name of the dataset.
fields.types: Terms to describe the nature of the data.
fields.version: The version number, or the release point of the dataset.
